name: SparkLend

repos.scope: SparkLend is a direct Aave V3 fork (sparkdotfi/sparklend-v1-core forked from aave/aave-v3-core). The Aave V3 subgraph framework/template is the standard way SparkLend markets on Ethereum + Gnosis are indexed; deployments of this template against the Spark Pool addresses serve the GraphQL endpoints referenced in Spark docs.
repos.verified: Confirmed sparklend-v1-core README states 'core smart contracts of the Aave V3 protocol' (fork of aave/aave-v3-core). Checked github.com/sparkdotfi org repo list (43 repos): only contracts/deployments/governance repos, NO first-party subgraph. Indexing relies on the reusable Aave V3 subgraph code applied to Spark Pool addresses.

notes: Aave V3 fork (MakerDAO/Sky subDAO) on Ethereum + Gnosis. No official Spark-owned subgraph repo. Spark docs reference per-network subgraphs queried via The Graph; these are Aave-V3-template deployments. has_public_indexer=true via the reusable/official Aave V3 subgraph code; an exact Spark deployment manifest is not first-party.

name: Babylon Protocol

repos.scope: Official Babylon BTC-staking indexer: syncs delegation and finality-provider events from both the Babylon chain (BBN) and Bitcoin, stores in MongoDB, feeds the staking API.
repos.verified: WebFetched repo: Go (98.3%), 197 commits, 37 releases, latest v3.0.9 (2026-01-12). Description confirms it indexes Babylon BTC staking delegation + finality-provider events. Official babylonlabs-io org.

repos.scope: Official API service consuming the staking-indexer's processed events (RabbitMQ + MongoDB) to serve staking data to the frontend.
repos.verified: Found in babylonlabs-io org alongside the indexer; companion API layer per Babylon docs (Staking Indexer service).

notes: Bitcoin staking protocol. Custom Go indexer rather than a subgraph (Bitcoin + Cosmos-SDK chain, not EVM). Official and actively maintained. Note: an older github.com/babylonlabs-io/staking-indexer also exists (phase-1).

name: BlackRock BUIDL
notes: Tokenized money-market fund issued via Securitize (custodial, permissioned transfer-agent ERC20). No public protocol indexer/subgraph; data held by Securitize. Token transfers visible on standard explorers but no dedicated public BUIDL indexer repo. Low-priority custodial RWA.

name: JustLend
notes: TRON Compound-fork lending protocol. Contracts open-sourced (github.com/justlend/justlend-protocol, justlend-interface) but NO public subgraph/indexer repo. TRON historically unsupported by The Graph hosted service; recent Graph/Substreams TRON support announced but no public JustLend-specific indexer repo found. Marked false (no verifiable public indexer repo).

name: Circle USYC
notes: Tokenized yield coin (formerly Hashnote USYC, now Circle). Custodial/permissioned RWA token. No public protocol subgraph/indexer repo found. Low-priority custodial RWA.

name: Tether Gold
notes: Gold-backed token (XAUt) issued by Tether. Custodial wrapper token, no protocol mechanics to index beyond ERC20 transfers. No public subgraph/indexer repo. Low-priority custodial RWA wrapper.

name: ether.fi Stake

repos.scope: ether.fi operates a live, official subgraph (The Graph Studio endpoint api.studio.thegraph.com/query/58515/etherfi-v2-main) indexing eETH/weETH staking, validators, EtherFiNode, and bid/auction events. The manifest source is not published as a standalone repo; closest official code home is the smart-contracts org repo.
repos.verified: Confirmed live subgraph endpoint 'etherfi-v2-main' (per ether.fi node-operators docs, which document querying validators/bids/EtherFiNode by block/bidder). Checked github.com/etherfi-protocol org (10 repos: smart-contracts, cash-v3, weETH-cross-chain, avs-smart-contracts, etc.) — NO standalone subgraph repo published; the deployed subgraph source is not open.

notes: Liquid restaking protocol. An OFFICIAL deployed subgraph exists and is actively served (etherfi-v2-main on The Graph Studio), but its manifest/mappings source code is not published in a public repo. has_public_indexer=true on the basis of the live official subgraph; the repo link points to the official protocol code org rather than a dedicated subgraph repo (none found).

name: Arbitrum Bridge
notes: Canonical L1<>L2 bridge for Arbitrum. TVL is escrow contracts on Ethereum. Bridge activity is observable via Arbitrum SDK / Offchain Labs infra and the arbitrum-sdk, but there is no dedicated public 'Arbitrum Bridge' subgraph/indexer repo for the canonical bridge as a TVL protocol. Low-priority canonical bridge; marked false.

name: Ondo Yield Assets
notes: Ondo OUSG/USDY tokenized treasuries. Contracts open-sourced (github.com/ondoprotocol/usdy) but NO public subgraph/indexer repo found. Permissioned/KYC'd RWA ERC20 tokens; data via RWA.xyz and issuer, not a public protocol indexer. Marked false.

name: KuCoin
notes: Centralized exchange. TVL is custodial wallet balances across many chains. No public on-chain indexer/subgraph for the exchange. CEX — marked false after confirming search.

name: Grove Finance
notes: Sky-ecosystem institutional credit allocator (a Sky 'Star') routing USDS into credit strategies via non-custodial vaults. Allocator positions live inside the Sky/Spark ALM and Morpho/Aave indexers rather than a dedicated Grove indexer. No public grove-finance subgraph/indexer repo found. Marked false.

name: Base Bridge
notes: Canonical Base (OP Stack) L1 bridge. TVL = escrow on Ethereum. Bridge deposits/withdrawals observable via OP Stack tooling, but no dedicated public 'Base Bridge' TVL subgraph/indexer repo. Low-priority canonical bridge; marked false.

name: Polygon Bridge
notes: Canonical Polygon PoS/zkEVM bridge. TVL = escrow contracts on Ethereum. No dedicated public 'Polygon Bridge' TVL subgraph/indexer repo; bridge data comes from Polygon's own infra/SDK. Low-priority canonical bridge; marked false.

name: Spark Liquidity Layer
notes: Spark's cross-chain ALM (Asset-Liability Management) layer; on-chain components in github.com/sparkdotfi/spark-alm-controller (contracts only, not an indexer). No dedicated public subgraph/indexer repo; allocations are observed within Sky/Spark + venue (Aave/Morpho) indexers. Spark publishes a data dashboard (data.spark.fi) backed by internal tooling. Marked false (no public indexer repo).

name: Portal
notes: Portal Token Bridge by Wormhole. Wormhole-foundation org has extensive infra (wormhole reference impl, connect, scaffolding) and runs its own Wormholescan explorer/Guardian network, but there is NO public The-Graph/Ponder-style subgraph indexing Portal bridge TVL. Cross-chain message indexing is done by the Guardian/spy + Wormholescan stack (not a discrete public 'Portal subgraph' repo). Marked false for a standard public subgraph/indexer; bridge data is served by Wormhole's own (largely internal) explorer backend.

name: Maple

repos.scope: Maple operates a live OFFICIAL subgraph on The Graph decentralized network (Maple Finance Ethereum, subgraph id 5H97eNhy9fVHcqRXZtCV2UxHG2DbzcFA7yth1TaVZ45x) indexing pools, loans, lenders and the Maple v2 lending markets. The manifest/mappings source is not published as a standalone repo; maple-core-v2 is the official protocol code home.
repos.verified: Confirmed published subgraph 'Maple Finance Ethereum' exists on Graph Explorer (id 5H97eN...VZ45x). Checked github.com/maple-labs (~82 repos): repos are contracts/SDK/docs (maple-core-v2, maple-js, syrup-utils, etc.) — searching the org for subgraph/graph/indexer returned 0 matches. The deployed subgraph's source is not open; repo link points to official protocol code.

notes: Institutional lending (Maple/Syrup). OFFICIAL deployed subgraph on The Graph decentralized network confirmed, but no public source repo for it in maple-labs (likely Goldsky/Studio-hosted closed source). has_public_indexer=true on basis of the live official subgraph.

name: Steakhouse Financial

repos.scope: Steakhouse is a vault CURATOR, not a standalone protocol — its ~48 vaults are MetaMorpho/Morpho Blue + Aave vaults. Those positions are indexed by the Morpho Blue subgraph (markets, vaults, allocations, curators) and the official Morpho subgraphs, where Steakhouse-curated vaults appear as vault entities.
repos.verified: Steakhouse confirmed (Morpho blog / governance) as the largest Morpho curator with 48 vaults across Ethereum/Base/Katana/Polygon/Unichain/Arbitrum. Their own org github.com/Steakhouse-Financial holds only vault-v2-supervisor (governance/ops contracts), NOT an indexer. Curated TVL is indexed via Morpho's subgraphs (morpho-blue-subgraph) per Morpho docs/subgraphs deployment page.

notes: Risk curator / capital allocator, not its own protocol. No first-party indexer (own org has only vault-v2-supervisor). TVL is curated MetaMorpho vaults indexed by the official Morpho Blue subgraph. has_public_indexer=true via the venue (Morpho) indexer that captures Steakhouse-curated vaults; no dedicated Steakhouse subgraph.

name: Crypto-com
notes: Centralized exchange (custodial wallet balances). No public on-chain indexer/subgraph for the exchange. CEX — marked false after confirming search.

name: Sentora
notes: Risk curator / analytics firm (merger of IntoTheBlock + Trident; curates lending vaults). Like other curators, its TVL is curated positions in venues (Morpho/Aave/etc.) indexed by those venues' subgraphs, not a dedicated Sentora indexer. No public first-party Sentora subgraph/indexer repo found. Marked false (no dedicated public indexer repo; positions covered by venue indexers e.g. Morpho).

name: JustCryptos
notes: JUST (TRON) wrapped/bridged crypto assets (e.g. JST/wrapped BTC-ETH on TRON). Token-wrapper bridge on TRON. No public subgraph/indexer repo (TRON, and a thin wrapper). Low-priority wrapper bridge; marked false.

name: Paxos Gold
notes: PAXG gold-backed token by Paxos. Custodial RWA wrapper ERC20; nothing protocol-specific to index beyond transfers. No public subgraph/indexer repo. Low-priority custodial RWA wrapper; marked false.

name: Spark Savings
notes: Spark Savings (sUSDS/sUSDC savings vaults, ERC4626-style) within the Sky/Spark ecosystem. No dedicated public subgraph/indexer repo in github.com/sparkdotfi (org has contracts/governance only, incl. spark-savings-intents contract repo). Savings rate/positions tracked via Spark's own data.spark.fi dashboard (internal tooling) and generic ERC4626 indexers, not a public Spark indexer. Marked false (no public indexer repo).

notes: OTC/exchange running on Provenance Blockchain (Cosmos-SDK). No protocol-specific public indexer/subgraph. name: Centrifuge Protocol

repos.scope: Official Ponder-based EVM indexer for Centrifuge V3. Indexes pools, vaults, share classes, holdings, cross-chain messaging and related entities across the multichain deployment; exposes a GraphQL API (api.centrifuge.io). Chain config via PONDER_RPC_URL_<chainId> / src/chains.ts.
repos.verified: WebFetched: described as 'A blockchain event indexer for the Centrifuge protocol, built with Ponder.' 399 commits, latest release v3.8.1 (2026-05-01), CI/CD pipeline. Handler/service architecture subscribing to Centrifuge contract events. Official centrifuge org.

repos.scope: Official SubQuery-based indexer/GraphQL API for the Centrifuge Parachain (Polkadot) — pools, tranches, investments on the Substrate chain.
repos.verified: WebFetched: description 'A GraphQL API to query the Centrifuge Parachain on Polkadot' built with SubQuery. 519 commits, latest release v2.4.0 (2025-07-21). TypeScript. Official centrifuge org. (Complements api-v3 which covers the EVM/V3 side.)

repos.verified: Confirmed schema.graphql indexes Tinlake pools/loans (pool IDs, loans, total debt). Official centrifuge org; legacy Tinlake era.

notes: Already-known RWA protocol. THREE official indexers across eras: api-v3 (Ponder, EVM V3, active), api (SubQuery, Polkadot parachain, active), tinlake-subgraph (The Graph, legacy). Rich first-party indexing. has_public_indexer=true.
